description:
The Luna Ultra online launch event is now live. Discover everything you need to know about our new gimbal camera line. Key features include:

- 10-bit I-Log for greater flexibility and precision in professional color grading 
- Detachable 2" OLED touchscreen for flexible framing and real-time shot control 
- Leica Summicron lens with 1" 8K sensor for exceptional detail and clarity in low light 
- Pro-grade telephoto lens for natural compression and cinematic bokeh (Ultra only)
- Triple AI chip system for enhanced low-light performance and cleaner image quality  (Ultra only)
- True-to-life portraits with natural skin tones and accurate depth rendering 
- Leica color profiles for iconic, cinematic tones straight out of camera 
- 3-axis stabilization for smooth, steady footage in motion
- QR Color Share for sharing color settings between devices

Join @BrandonLiUnscripted, @AndrasRa_, @LeicaCameraGlobal, and the Insta360 team for this exclusive launch event.
